evals.name: repeated-status-checks
evals.prompt: Refactor a component that checks paymentStatus seven times across its heading, body, actions, and analytics effect.
evals.expected_output: Resolves the status at an owning boundary, keeps meaningful shared work shared, and reduces repeated consultations without changing behavior.

assertions.text: Counts or identifies repeated status consultations
Chooses a boundary that owns the divergent behavior

evals.name: local-guard-left-local
evals.prompt: Review a function whose only conditional is an early return when the input list is empty.
evals.expected_output: Leaves the clear local guard in place rather than extracting a branch abstraction.

assertions.text: Treats the single guard as harmless
Does not split the function or introduce dispatch machinery

evals.name: review-only-branching
evals.prompt: Review this reducer for nested and repeated decisions, but don't change it.
evals.expected_output: Reports the decisions, locations, counts or depth, and proposed boundary without editing.

assertions.text: Reports repeated consultations or nesting depth

evals.name: implement-preserves-convergence
evals.prompt: Flatten this three-mode import flow. All modes validate differently, then call the same persist function and emit the same success event.
evals.expected_output: Separates divergent validation while retaining one shared persistence and success path, then runs checks.

assertions.text: Keeps the shared persistence and event code single
Does not duplicate convergence code into each mode

evals.name: duplication-routes-away
evals.prompt: Two unrelated modules contain similar five-line date formatting blocks, but neither has repeated or nested conditions. Use flatten-branching to clean them up.
evals.expected_output: Explains that this is a consolidation question, not a branching problem, and does not force a branch refactor.

assertions.text: Identifies consolidation as the relevant concern
Does not invent a control-flow change
